name: Appartements Alpenkristall
beschreibung: Appartements Alpenkristall is located in the district of Söll, offering a peaceful location at the foot of the Kaisergebirge mountains. An adjacent traditional inn features an on-site restaurant and drinks service. The accommodation units are designed as self-catering holiday apartments with kitchenettes. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi and parking directly at the property. The centre of Söll, with its local shops and access to the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser ski resort, is reachable within a few minutes' walk. Guests will appreciate solid, traditional Tyrolean-style accommodation offering complete flexibility for a self-guided holiday.
